bugs_found: transfer is not atomic: account_from.balance is debited before validating account_to.balance, so an exception can leave balances inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal before comparisons/arithmetic, which can cause TypeError or inconsistent Receipt amount types
apply_fee can return a negative amount when fee_min exceeds amount
fx_convert accepts zero or negative exchange rates, producing invalid conversions
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate fractional years/months/compounds_per_year via int() instead of rejecting invalid non-integer inputs
